title: Love the colors and quality, don't love the sheen or dots..
text: Love the colors and quality, don't love the sheen or dots... Love the colors and ombre look, I don't love how it's shiny and the dots all over it. 5 stars for quality and colors but only gave 3 for other named reasons.

product_metadata.title: Creative Home Ideas – Textured Fabric Shower Curtain Set | Includes 12 Easy Glide Metal Rings | Modern Bathroom Décor | Machine Washable | Measures 72” X 72” | Aqua Ombre Leaves
features: 𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗟𝗘𝗧𝗘 𝗟𝗨𝗫𝗨𝗥𝗬 𝗦𝗘𝗧 – Each Creative Home Ideas shower curtain set includes and 12 beaded roller free gliding metal shower rings. The small roller balls reduce friction for effortless gliding across the rod

𝗗𝗨𝗥𝗔𝗕𝗟𝗘 𝗤𝗨𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Made from durable, wrinkle-resistant 100% polyester and features reinforced header and hook holes. The fade resistant fabric and rust resistant metal shower hooks are built to last. Fits all standard shower curtain rods
𝗕𝗔𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗢𝗢𝗠 𝗗𝗘𝗖𝗢𝗥 – Modernize your bathroom with a fresh ombre fading shower curtain. The beautiful textured design is available in 11 colors and will match any style
𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗬 𝗧𝗢 𝗖𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗡 & 𝗠𝗔𝗖𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗘 𝗪𝗔𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗕𝗟𝗘 – Wash in cold water using a mild detergent and gentle cycle. Tumble dry on low and remove promptly. Iron on low heat on the reverse side

𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗩𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗔𝗟 𝗦𝗜𝗭𝗜𝗡𝗚, 𝗘𝗔𝗦𝗬 𝗧𝗢 𝗜𝗡𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗟𝗟 – All Creative Home Ideas shower curtains are designed to fit curved, straight, and adjustable shower curtain rods. Measures 70-inches by 72-inches. Vinyl or PEVA shower curtain liner recommended but sold separately
description: Spruce up your bathroom décor with the Ombre Leaves Shower Curtain Collection by Creative Home Ideas. With a falling leaves woven design, your bathroom will now bring a cozy vibe to your home. Set includes (1) 70 x72 inch shower curtain with a button hole header and (12) silver metal hooks for easy set-up. Liner not included, recommended to purchase separately. Available in several colors: grey, blue, and aqua. Machine wash cold, gentle cycle with mild detergent. Wash separately. Only non-chlorine bleach when needed. Tumble dry low. 100% Polyester. Imported.
